# Vendored third-party files

Copied unmodified from npm on 2026-11-10 so the site has no runtime CDN dependency.

| Path | Package | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `leaflet/leaflet.js`, `leaflet/leaflet.css` | leaflet 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause (`leaflet/LICENSE`) |
| `geo/topojson-client.min.js` | topojson-client 3.1.0 | ISC, © Mike Bostock |
| `geo/countries-50m.json` | world-atlas 2.0.2 (Natural Earth 1:50m, v4.1.0) | ISC packaging; Natural Earth data is public domain |

Country outlines are Natural Earth's de facto boundaries and are drawn only for
orientation. They are not a statement about any border.
